key.name: selected-image
key.description: Path of the last image applied to the GDM login screen.

key.name: desktop-image-label
key.description: Original display name of the managed desktop wallpaper.

key.name: login-image-label
key.description: Original display name of the managed login background.

key.name: plymouth-image
key.description: Path of the last image successfully applied to the boot and shutdown screen.

key.name: plymouth-image-label
key.description: Original display name of the managed boot and shutdown background.

key.name: image-directory
key.description: Directory displayed in the extension image gallery.

key.name: show-panel-icon
key.description: Whether to show the Ubuntu Appearance icon in the top panel.

key.name: show-network-speed
key.description: Whether to show live download and upload speeds in the top panel.

key.name: network-speed-unit
key.description: Display network speed in bytes or bits per second.

key.name: network-speed-position
key.description: Display the network speed indicator on the left or right.

key.name: bing-download-enabled
key.description: Whether to check and download the Bing daily image in the background.

key.name: bing-market
key.description: Market used when requesting the Bing daily image.

key.name: bing-resolution
key.description: Resolution used when downloading Bing images.

key.name: bing-delete-old
key.description: Whether downloaded Bing images older than the retention period are deleted.

key.name: bing-retention-days
key.description: Number of days to retain downloaded Bing images.

key.name: bing-download-history
key.description: Compact JSON record used for deduplication and cleanup.

key.name: bing-favorite-images
key.description: Bing image identifiers protected from automatic cleanup.

key.name: bing-manual-download-days
key.description: Number of recent Bing daily images requested manually.

key.name: bing-download-request
key.description: Incremented by preferences to request a manual download.

key.name: bing-processed-download-request
key.description: Last manual download request completed by the background service.

key.name: bing-download-state
key.description: Current downloader state: idle, downloading, success or error.

key.name: bing-last-download-count
key.description: Number of new image files written by the last request.

key.name: bing-download-error
key.description: Error produced by the last Bing request.

key.name: hide-firmware-logo
key.description: Whether the Plymouth theme hides the firmware manufacturer logo.
